source: RRB NTPC CEN syllabus as published in the Railway Recruitment Board notices (rrbapply.gov.in and regional RRB sites)
intro: CBT 1 and CBT 2 use the same three subjects. CBT 1 only screens, CBT 2 decides merit, and the skill stage (typing test or aptitude test) depends on the post you are targeting.
note: The RRB syllabus is given as broad areas in the notice. CBT 2 asks the same areas as CBT 1, but with more questions and at a harder level.

sections.name: Mathematics
topics: Number system, BODMAS, decimals and fractions, LCM and HCF
Simple and compound interest, profit and loss
Time and work, time and distance, pipes and cisterns
Elementary statistics, square roots, age calculations, calendar and clock

sections.name: General Intelligence and Reasoning
topics: Alphabetical and number series, coding and decoding
Syllogism, Venn diagrams, statement and conclusions, statement and assumptions
Jumbling, data interpretation and sufficiency, analytical reasoning, decision making

sections.name: General Awareness
topics: Current affairs of national and international importance
Games and sports, art and culture, Indian literature, monuments and places
History, geography, Indian polity and constitution, Indian economy
General science, life science up to Class 10 level, environmental issues
Computer applications, transport systems, abbreviations, flagship government programmes

sections.name: Typing test or aptitude test
topics: Typing skill test (CBTST) for posts such as accounts clerk and junior clerk, with the speed given in the notice
Computer-based aptitude test (CBAT) for station master and similar posts, with no negative marking
